question: Does the paper report the performance of the model for each individual language?
title: X-Stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
answer_rationale: The documents discuss model performance in cross-lingual and cross-target settings, mention multilingual BERT, and reference tables with results, but none explicitly report performance for each individual language. While language ratios and model choices are mentioned, specific performance metrics per language are not detailed.
